 Match Preview
 LaLiga - Game Week 13 Nov 20, 2026 - 15:00 San Mames Athletic Bilbao welcome Espanyol to San Mames in Bilbao for a LaLiga fixture on Sunday, December 6, 2026.
 Edin Terzic's side come into this match in solid domestic form, sitting seventh in the table and having won three of their last five across all competitions. A 2-1 victory over Real Sociedad in early November showed their quality at home, though a draw against Osasuna last time out was a minor dip.
 Espanyol arrive in Bilbao in a more difficult spell. Eder Sarabia's team sit 13th in LaLiga and have won just once in their last five competitive outings, with defeats to Racing Santander and Atletico Madrid compounding an early Copa del Rey exit against Sestao.
 The absences list will shape both teams' selections. Athletic are without several key figures through injury, while Espanyol also carry fitness concerns into the trip north.
 San Mames has long been one of Spanish football's most atmospheric grounds, and the Basque crowd will be looking to push their side toward a result that consolidates their top-half standing.
